caption:
By time, indeed mankind is in loss, except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

Surah Al-Asr (103:1-3). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Two independent live fetches this session (2026-11-10) of GET /v1/surah/103/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese, HTTP 200 each, diffed: byte-identical. Source artifact: the API prepends the basmalah to ayah 1 of this surah; it was removed (exact-prefix strip, asserted in code) because it is not part of the verse. No other change. Raw ayah 1: "بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَصْرِ"
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (en.sahih). Verbatim, ayahs joined by a space: "By time, Indeed, mankind is in loss, Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience."
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian (zh.jian). Verbatim, ayahs joined by a space: "以时光盟誓， 一切人确是在亏折之中， 惟信道而且行善，并以真理相劝，以坚忍相勉的人则不然。"
sourcing.korean: ko.korean; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', credited on-slide as not specified. Raw: "세월을 두고 맹세하사 실로 모든 인간은 멸망케 되 니라 그러나 믿음으로 의로운 일을실천하며 서로가 서로에게 진리를권고하며 인내하는 자들은 제외라". Spacing-only fixes: '되 니라' -> '되니라'; '일을실천하며' -> '일을 실천하며'; '진리를권고하며' -> '진리를 권고하며'. Whitespace-stripped text verified identical to raw. No wording changed.
sourcing.japanese: ja.japanese; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', cited as such. Verbatim, ayahs concatenated: "時間にかけて（誓う）。本当に人間は，喪失の中にいる。信仰して善行に勤しみ，互いに真理を勧めあい，また忍耐を勧めあう者たちの外は。"
sourcing.verification_note: All renderings from two live api.alquran.cloud fetches this session, diffed identical; none from memory. Manual halal compliance check against scripts/data/compliance-policy.json blocklists: typography only, no imagery. Dupcheck against fresh clone of origin/main (c1b27ea): quran:103:1-3 NEW.
